# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph's Rule; The End of the Story

---

**1** Joseph was wise and discerning in all his ways, and he prospered in everything he did, for the Lord God was with him.

**2** Joseph ruled Egypt for eighty years. In his time Egypt enjoyed peace and prosperity, for Joseph administered the land's affairs with wisdom.

**3** Joseph's name was great throughout the land, and his fame spread to the ends of the earth.

**4** The children of Israel multiplied greatly in Egypt and became mighty and very numerous.

**5** Joseph loved Aseneth all the days of his life, and she was his only wife.

**6** Aseneth was honored in the house of Joseph and among all the people of Egypt, and she was called the mother of all who take refuge in the Lord God Most High.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
